summary: GL and context code was hardened for Metal via ANGLE: synchronization now uses eglWaitUntilWorkScheduledANGLE and MTLSharedEvent so WebRender and WebGL activity line up with Core Animation transactions, and compositing waits for commands to be scheduled. There are also GL readback fixes (SwizzleYFlipData) and smarter depth/stencil allocation. These changes make WebGL and compositing more reliable and reduce visual sync or readback errors on Metal/ANGLE platforms.
